notes: Math.random = mulberry32(seed), counted in `draws`. Per frame f (t = f*dt): set the deck velocity (vxAmp sin(0.05 t), 0, vz); apply the events of frame f in order; update(dt); syncPuffs(camera c0 + cv*f, palette). Poses: a = phase + w*t (t frozen at crashedAt), position (cx + r sin a, cy or crashY, cz + r cos a), quaternion axisAngle(Y, a + PI/2) * axisAngle(Z, bank), velocity (r w cos a, 0, -r w sin a) or 0 once crashed; isAlive f < deadAt; undefined from goneAt. Anchors (t = (f - from)*dt, false from goneAt): slide d = t < T ? speed (t - t^2/(2T)) : speed T/2 along (dirX, 0, dirZ); fall (x + vx t, max(floor, y + vy t - 4.903325 t^2), z + vz t); fixed; deck (x, y, z + vz t). After a rebase, pose position/orientation/velocity and anchor points are carried through that FrameShift. Ground: wavy base + sx x + sz z + amp sin(0.05 x) cos(0.04 z); deck: deck.y on xMin..xMax else 0. Water test (when waterBelowX is set): x < waterBelowX and not on the deck strip. Surface probe: deck strip concrete, water, concrete range, else dirt. Deck contains |y - deck.y| < 3 and x on the strip. Hashes: FNV-1a over the float32 prefix of instanceMatrix (16 per puff), ditherLevel, toneA, toneB; flags = the live puffs' kind bytes in slot order. state = [active leaks, anchored fires, burn spots, fuel drops in flight, active pools, pool points]. marks = [pool marks, burn marks, FNV-1a over the rows as float64, pool rows first]; pool rows [x, y, z, dirX, dirZ, length, width, char], burn rows [x, y, z, radius, strength, grow] (written out in full for the first ~40 marks).
